Partner console sign-in

Credentialed access to partner sections

Sign in

The dashboard, certifications and remittance sections require partner credentials. Credentials are issued by the records office once a registration has been accepted.

Trouble signing in

Reset a forgotten password · Request credentials

Credentials are issued to the work email on an accepted registration. The records office cannot read a password out over the phone.
